{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
qa_count = df[qa_mask].shape[0]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {qa_count}")

# Remove QA orders from the dataset
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = df_clean[(df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df_clean['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers (excluding QA): {mean_revenue}")"}
